OUR HOME REMODELING PROCESS

At GMH Construction we use a three-step approach to help homeowners understand their options, improve the accuracy of project cost prior to the construction contract, and ultimately, maximize the return on the investment for the homeowner.

Step 1: Consultation

Meeting to discuss your project at your home allows us to identify the scope of the job and discuss pre-construction and renovation processes. We will then contact you for a follow-up appointment in approximately 2 to 3 weeks to present a Design Retainer. The Design Retainer outlines the scope of work, project budget range, and estimated engagement time with our designers.

Step 2: The Design Process

The Design Retainer allows us to design intelligently and accurately estimate the project cost. This important work has great value: accurate budgets, excellent design, maximum return on investment, better planning by the contractor, and better decision-making by the homeowner. A well-designed and well-built home is less expensive to live in, maintain, heat, and cool.

Our designers will guide you through the decision-making and selection process to achieve your renovation goals. By the end of the design process, we will have a finalized budget and scope of work to create a detailed Construction Contract.

Step 3: Construction Contract

Signing the Construction Contract is the final step which includes scheduling a start date for your project. We pride ourselves on creating accurate contracts, realistic schedules, and good quality control to assure outstanding results. For most projects, we have a fixed price contract, which outlines the scope of work to be completed, and the cost to complete the job.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What time do the crews work?

We generally begin our day at 7:00 and end at 4:00. However, we work with each client to determine good starting times for their family.

Who will be supervising my job?

One of the owners, Greg or Dane, will come and meet with you to discuss your ideas, plan your project and write your bid. During the design process Robin or Audrey, and their team of design/construction professionals will work with you to design, specify and price your project.

When you decide to start the project, Greg and Dane will consistently be present at your home throughout the remodeling process to assure quality workmanship, accurate implementation of the contract and that you are always satisfied with the work. Remember Greg and Dane are always available to you by cell phone.

We love our new kitchen!

From the moment, we sat down with Greg, we trusted him and knew that he was our contractor.
He was meticulous in taking measurements and making sure he understood what we were looking for. This was important because we wanted a wall removed, storage created, and relevant function in our kitchen. The second time we met with Greg, he had a machine-prepared sketch of our home so we could conceptualize the placement of cabinets, appliances, and lighting.
As it turned out, he, his team, and his suppliers exceeded our expectations while keeping costs close to our budget.
When the cabinet costs seemed to take off to the stratosphere, he found a solution that allowed us to have the wood we chose and still have the quality we wanted. Greg did not just turn us over to a cabinet supplier, he was there in the meeting when we hit a bump in the road.
The sub-contractors previewed the work and showed up on time to keep the process moving. They were professional as well as friendly with our very inquisitive dog.
Every day, the crew cleaned up so we could continue to live in the house during major construction. GMH also uses a unique air filtering device. It is a super-giant HEPA filter that keeps the dust down in the rest of the house.
The craftsmanship was better than we could have ever hoped. Their carpenters are true woodworkers and pay meticulous attention to the tightness of joints and finished color in all light situations. The detailed method they used was far beyond our expectations.
I don’t think we had many changes to the original plan, but GMH was quick to respond and discuss cost impacts.
There were recommendations by GMH that we had never considered and made our new kitchen complete and enjoyable. The richness added by the addition of furniture ends to our cabinets is more than we could have ever hoped for.
The project was completed in less than their anticipated timeline which was a big bonus for us.
I should mention that being a NARI contractor, they were sure to have all the necessary permits from the city and the inspectors were scheduled so as not to cause a delay in the project.
We were so impressed by every facet of GMH, that we had them do our bathroom while we went on vacation. Once again, they exceeded our expectations and the bathroom is stunning.

Customized Kitchen Cabinets

Our team of kitchen remodelers collaborates with you, assimilating your requirements and style to design a kitchen island that not only complements your kitchen remodel but significantly boosts your kitchen workflow.

Modern Kitchen Lighting Solutions

Effective lighting forms the lifeblood of a warm, inviting kitchen. Our kitchen restorers ensure your kitchen remodel embodies the ideal balance of ambient, task, and accent lighting to curate the perfect atmosphere and practical functionality in your space.

Durable and Attractive Flooring Options

Our kitchen remodeling experts assist you in making an informed choice, leading you to a flooring solution that is as attractive as it is robust and low-maintenance.

Smart Storage and Organization Solutions

Our designs incorporate clever storage solutions, enabling you to maintain an organized, clutter-free kitchen.
